name: zoxide
why: Frecency-based 'cd' (z foo); a faster, maintained successor to the autojump plugin.

name: direnv
why: Per-directory env loading; could replace autoenv/dotenv and manual ~/.work_env sourcing.

name: atuin
why: Searchable, context-aware shell history (by directory, session, exit code).

name: git-delta
why: Syntax-highlighted, side-by-side git diffs; easier review of agent-generated changes.

name: lazygit
why: Fast git TUI for staging hunks and rebasing; pairs well with a tmux popup.

name: bat
why: cat with syntax highlighting; drop-in fzf previewer.

name: eza
why: Modern ls with git status and tree view.

name: sesh
why: Smart tmux session manager; complements the work/personal session launchers.

name: just
why: Simple project command runner; gives agents a discoverable list of tasks.

name: ast-grep
why: Structural code search/rewrite; precise large refactors for you and coding agents.

name: gum
why: Polished prompts and spinners for shell scripts and interactive wizards.

name: gemini-cli
why: Terminal AI agent; handy for quick one-off tasks outside the IDE.

name: llm
why: Pipe text through LLMs from the shell (summaries, commit messages, explanations).

name: repomix
why: Pack a repo into one AI-friendly file to give agents full context.
